result.document_summary: SF.gov Rent Board news notice announcing that Rent Ordinance Section 37.10C, effective October 14, 2024, prohibits the sale or use of algorithmic devices to set rents or manage occupancy for San Francisco residential units.
result.notes: Single rule extracted. The page names the Rent Ordinance (S.F. Admin. Code ch. 37) and Section 37.10C; the citation is built from that. No coverage conditions or exemptions are stated on the page, so coverage is left unconditioned.

rules.title: Ban on algorithmic devices to set rents or manage occupancy (Rent Ordinance Section 37.10C)
rules.requirement: The sale or use of algorithmic devices (software that analyzes nonpublic competitor rental data to recommend rents for vacant units) to set rents or manage occupancy levels for residential units is prohibited. Tenants or the City Attorney may bring a civil action for violations.
rules.key_value: Ban on sale or use of algorithmic rent-setting devices
rules.quoted_span: The law prohibits the sale or use of algorithmic devices to set rents or manage occupancy levels for residential units in San Francisco.
rules.coverage_text: Applies to the sale or use of algorithmic devices for setting rents or managing occupancy of residential units in San Francisco; no building-level conditions are stated.
